name: Drusilla Dreams
source:
The lovely Drusilla has overthrown her brother Caligula, and has become the Empress of the Roman Empire! With all the power of the known world at her fingertips our Drusilla has only one problem, her love life! 

Drusilla Dreams is a short yuri style visual novel about the loving relationship between Drusilla, and her favorite slave Lucca. 

Will the burdens of being a slave affect their love for one another? Will the empire fall into rebellion because they have a woman in charge!? Where is Caligula? Does anyone even care!?

[From [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/458060/]Steam[/url]]

Sequel to the RPG [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/454570/]I am Caligula[/url].
translation:
可爱的德鲁西拉推翻了兄长卡利古拉，成为罗马帝国的女皇！已知世界的全部权力都掌握在她手中，德鲁西拉唯一的问题就是爱情生活！

《Drusilla Dreams》是一部短篇百合风格视觉小说，讲述德鲁西拉与她最喜爱的奴隶卢卡之间的爱情关系。

奴隶身份会影响她们的感情吗？帝国会因为由女性统治而陷入叛乱吗？！卡利古拉在哪里？有人在乎他吗？！

[来源：[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/458060/]Steam[/url]]

《I am Caligula》RPG的续作：[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/454570/]Steam[/url]。
